# M3 Expressive Paywall

> Six ready-to-use Material 3 Expressive paywall screens for Jetpack Compose (Android). Billing-agnostic: each paywall takes a list of PaywallPlan plus onPurchase, onRestore and onClose callbacks, and shows the price, billing period, trial terms and auto-renew text Google Play's subscription policy asks for. MIT license.

Install (JitPack): add `maven("https://jitpack.io")`, then `implementation("com.github.sanikantv:m3-expressive-paywall:v1.0.0")`. Requires minSdk 26 and compileSdk 37; brings androidx.compose.material3 1.5.0-beta02.

- [Getting started](https://paywall.sanikant.dev/getting-started/): install, first paywall, theming
- [All designs](https://paywall.sanikant.dev/components/): overview of the six paywalls
- [PaywallPlan and models](https://paywall.sanikant.dev/components/paywall-plan/): data classes and disclosure text
- [FAQ](https://paywall.sanikant.dev/faq/)
- [Comparison](https://paywall.sanikant.dev/comparison/): vs building it yourself, RevenueCat Paywalls, Superwall, Adapty, Qonversion
- [API reference](https://paywall.sanikant.dev/api/): Dokka

## Paywalls

- [ClassicPlansPaywall](https://paywall.sanikant.dev/components/classic-plans-paywall/): hero, plan cards with badge, features
- [ComparisonPaywall](https://paywall.sanikant.dev/components/comparison-paywall/): Free vs Pro table
- [TrialTimelinePaywall](https://paywall.sanikant.dev/components/trial-timeline-paywall/): Today, reminder, billing timeline
- [PlanPickerPaywall](https://paywall.sanikant.dev/components/plan-picker-paywall/): connected ToggleButton group, morphing card
- [LimitedOfferSheet](https://paywall.sanikant.dev/components/limited-offer-sheet/): discount bottom sheet, countdown, wavy progress
- [OnboardingPaywall](https://paywall.sanikant.dev/components/onboarding-paywall/): benefits pager ending in plans
